Linux artifact built in the ChatGPT build container:
  Architecture: x86_64
  CPython ABI: 3.13 (libpython3.13.so.1.0)
  Program: DiscordGlobalStatusMonitor.pyz (Python zipapp, Python 3.9+)
  Optional C ABI: discord_global_status.so (requires matching CPython 3.13 ABI)

Rebuild discord_global_status.so on the destination system with build_linux.sh
if its CPython ABI / architecture differs. The .so is not a standalone program.
A PyInstaller standalone ELF is produced by build_linux.sh when PyInstaller and
its build dependencies can be installed from the package index.
